stem: A sticky-card count is much higher than the previous round. What should the technician verify and record?
choices: Trap identity and location, the count method, and the change from the prior comparable round
Room temperature, recent irrigation events, and cultivar name while leaving the individual trap identity out of the trend record
The highest trap count in the room and whether visible crop damage is present, without confirming that the prior count used the same method
A room-wide average across all cards, because combining locations provides a more stable trend than preserving each trap's identity and position
rationale: Monitoring devices support trend interpretation when trap identity, location, counting method, and repeated observations are preserved so changes can be compared consistently over time.
